name: vakera-ganaderia
description: Sistema de Gestión y Trazabilidad Ganadera Vakera

scripts.py:test: python server_py/manage.py test core nutricion reportes
scripts.test:int: npm --prefix server run test:int && python -m pytest server_py -m integration
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage && python -m pytest server_py --cov=core --cov=nutricion --cov=reportes --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:client && npm run py:test
